description: Chaotic generator built from a sine oscillator whose phase is multiplied, offset and fed back into itself, ported from SuperCollider

params.text: Sets how often a new value is generated
Attenuverter for the S. Rate CV input, -1 to +1
Multiplies the phase going into the sine, setting how many times the waveform folds through itself
Attenuverter for the Index X CV input, -1 to +1
Adds a fixed amount to the phase at every step, which sets the underlying frequency
Attenuverter for the Phase + CV input, -1 to +1
Multiplies the running phase at every step, over a range of about 1 to 3, stretching and breaking up the phase
Attenuverter for the Phase X CV input, -1 to +1
Mixes the previous Out X value back into the sine's phase
Attenuverter for the Feedback CV input, -1 to +1
Normal wraps the phase with a plain modulo; Broken reflects negative phase values instead, which coarsens the output
Fast runs the generator across its full rate range; Slow divides that rate by 100 for modulation speeds
Stepped jumps to each new value; Slewed interpolates linearly between values, which doubles as a low-pass filter at audio rates
DC passes the output as generated; AC strips any DC offset out of it

inputs.text: A rising edge here generates one new value, replacing the internal rate clock
Modulates the generation rate, scaled by the S. Rate attenuverter
Modulates the phase multiplier going into the sine, scaled by the Index X attenuverter
Modulates the per-step phase offset, scaled by the Phase + attenuverter
Modulates the running phase multiplier, scaled by the Phase X attenuverter
Modulates the feedback amount, scaled by the Feedback attenuverter

outputs.text: The oscillator's own phase, wrapped and scaled to -5V to 5V

notes: the generation rate is set as a fraction of the patch's own sample rate, so changing the patch's sample rate changes the speed and the sound of what comes out.
